result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide multi-lane roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or medians increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light to reduce conflicts with turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows an urban street with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While a traffic signal is present, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the intersection create visibility challenges and increase pedestrian exposure.
